items.title: Google Just Released Its Craziest AI Project Yet
items.summary:
Get the FREE Dots PDF
https://learn.aiadvantage.com/free-ai-assistant-pdf

Join The AI Advantage Club
https://joinaiaclub.com/igor

Google just released one of the wildest things I’ve ever seen in AI. It’s still early, but I can’t stop thinking about where this could go. If this is what the beginning looks like, imagine what we’ll be doing with it a year from now. This is one of those moments worth paying attention to.

Explore Project Genie (eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers):
https://labs.google/projectgenie

Genie 4 announcement and demos:
https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation/

6:20 Why I’m Skipping GPT-6
